title: Pre-extract Java field classification is missing
wanted_capability: A pre-transform analysis that classifies candidate fields as static/final constants, mutable instance state, injected/provider dependencies, and read/write participants by method.
fallback_used: The probe cross-referenced cohesion cluster move_fields, raw modifier queries, and post-hoc extractClass captured-variable findings.
notes: Genericized from a private Java refactor probe. Raw modifier query results were misleading; the transform findings later identified mutable moved state correctly.
resolution_note: Implemented analysis.fieldClassification({ file, fields?, className? }) as a Java pre-extract field state surface. It classifies static-final constants, injected/provider fields, mutable instance state, and read/write sites grouped by enclosing method for seam planning.
